skinMechanics.attribute: data-skin on <html>, set by a pre-paint script in index.html and kept in sync by useSkin
skinMechanics.sharedBehaviour: frontend/src/shared, hooks and i18n; skins live in frontend/src/skins/<name>/ and are keyed so switching remounts the whole skin

display.purpose: Greeting headline, error SFX and logotype, always with the lettering treatment (paper-white fill, ink stroke, stepped ink extrusion, cyan and magenta plates out of register).

headline.purpose: Empty-state titles, meter count, button calls, ES/EN and skin plates and count chips in Bangers without plates.

title.purpose: Task titles and composer text; user content is always Archivo.

body.purpose: State explanations, caption summaries, toast text.

label.purpose: Metadata, filter tabs, status, meter caption, skin label; condensed via the wdth axis (85%, 78% on narrow viewports).

brutal-display.purpose: Bento greeting; uppercase, punctuation stripped, balanced.

brutal-numeral.purpose: Progress card count (3rem) and pending badge (1.875rem), tabular.

brutal-headline.purpose: Marquee phrases (1.25-1.5rem), empty-state titles, wordmark and completion stamp.

brutal-title.purpose: Task titles, composer text and the edit field.

brutal-label.purpose: Filter tabs, ES/EN and skin plates, status ticket, list hint, card strips; 0.65-0.7rem on pills, badge captions and tickets; drops to wdth 75-95% on narrow phones.

classic-display.purpose: Greeting headline (1.875rem, 2.25rem from 640px) followed by the waving hand.

classic-label.purpose: Metadata, status pill, ES/EN and skin segments, list hint, footer.

shadows.name: ink-extrusion
shadows.value: 1px 1px 0 var(--extrude), 2px 2px 0 var(--extrude), 3px 3px 0 var(--extrude), calc(var(--depth) - 1px) calc(var(--depth) - 1px) 0 var(--extrude), var(--depth) var(--depth) 0 var(--extrude)
shadows.purpose: Body of every inked panel. --depth 5px default; 8px task hover; 7px composer focus; 3px small controls and the skin switch; 2px completed tasks.

shadows.name: halftone-cast
shadows.value: background-image: radial-gradient(var(--cast) 34%, transparent 38%); background-size: 6px 6px; transform: translate(calc(var(--depth) + 6px), calc(var(--depth) + 7px))
shadows.purpose: Ben-Day dotted shadow behind every inked panel; --cast is rgb(20 16 31 / 0.55) by day, rgb(42 212 255 / 0.45) by night.

shadows.name: ink-offset
shadows.purpose: Flat ink drop under yellow buttons, narrator captions and icon tiles inside panels; 5px 5px on button hover. Toasts use 4px 4px 0 var(--extrude).

shadows.name: lettering-extrusion
shadows.value: text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 2px 2px 0 var(--ink), 3px 3px 0 var(--ink), 4px 4px 0 var(--ink), -3px -1px 0 var(--cyan), 7px 5px 0 var(--magenta)
shadows.purpose: Depth and plate misregistration for display lettering only.

shadows.name: brutal-slab-rest
shadows.purpose: Task slabs, bento cards, composer, state cards, toasts, add and retry buttons.

shadows.name: brutal-control-rest
shadows.purpose: Scale adaptation for small controls: icon buttons, theme toggle, ES/EN, skin and filter groups, footer links, logo tile, pending badge, completion stamp, error balloon, icon tiles.

shadows.name: brutal-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state of every pressable element, only under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

shadows.name: brutal-sticker-drop
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur silhouette shadow under the SVG stickers.

shadows.name: classic-card-hush
shadows.purpose: Pending task cards (with 1px zinc-200 border and backdrop-filter: blur(8px)).

shadows.name: classic-composer-focus
shadows.purpose: Composer while focused; at rest a zinc 5% shadow-sm.

shadows.name: classic-violet-glow
shadows.purpose: Gradient add button; the logo tile uses a shadow-lg at 30% violet.

shadows.name: classic-halo
shadows.purpose: Background violet/indigo/sky ellipse and fuchsia disc halos.

motion.name: on-twos
motion.value: ease: (p) => Math.floor(p * n) / n, or CSS steps(n)
motion.purpose: Stepped frames for every scripted transition: 4 frames for toggles, filter plate, exit and check mark; 6 for entrances and the composer shake; 8 for the meter fill; 13 for the burst.

motion.name: burst-pop
motion.purpose: Completion burst: scale 0.2 to 1.15 to 1, rotate -25deg to -8deg, hold, fade.

motion.name: burst-register
motion.purpose: Cyan and magenta plates settle from 7px out of register.

motion.name: skeleton-drift
motion.purpose: Halftone drift on loading ghost panels.

motion.name: depth-settle
motion.purpose: Transition of the extrusion and cast when --depth changes.

motion.name: direct-spring
motion.purpose: Reserved for direct hover/tap response and panel entrance; not for scripted sequences.

motion.name: brutal-press
motion.value: translate and box-shadow 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); background-color 0.15s ease; :active 0.06s
motion.purpose: User-pinned overshoot curve for the lift and sink of every pressable element; transition removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: brutal-entrance-spring
motion.value: spring 300/20, stagger 0.05s per item (max 8); bento 260/18 stagger 0.08s
motion.purpose: Slabs enter from 50px below with a ±3deg tilt; bento cards from 40px at -2deg. User-pinned spring physics.

motion.name: brutal-pop-spring
motion.value: badge 400/11; completion stamp 520/10 (clears after 1.4s); check 700/14; checkbox tap 600/15 to scale 0.8
motion.purpose: Bouncy pops for the pending badge, completion stamp and check.

motion.name: brutal-plate-spring
motion.purpose: Active filter plate moving between options.

motion.name: brutal-marquee
motion.value: base 2.2%/s; scroll velocity spring 400/50 mapped [-1500, 1500] px/s to factor [-5, 5]; direction follows scroll
motion.purpose: Scroll-accelerated ribbons; stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: brutal-cursor
motion.purpose: Reactive cursor; fine pointer only, disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: brutal-sticker-drag
motion.purpose: Draggable elastic SVG stickers (1024px and up).

motion.name: classic-ease-out
motion.purpose: Hero entrance (0.5s) and progress ring count-up (0.8s).

motion.name: classic-spring
motion.purpose: Card entrance and sliding segmented indicators; cards exit 40px left in 0.2s.

motion.name: classic-ambient
motion.value: halo breathe 16s and drift 20s ease-in-out infinite; shimmer 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; wave 2.4s ease-in-out 0.4s once
motion.purpose: Background halos, loading shimmer, the greeting wave (off under reduced motion).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Comic: parallax, skeleton drift, plate registration and burst pop off (burst falls back to a fade). Brutal: press transition, marquee and cursor off. Classic: wave and status ping off.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Classic wordmark text appears; Brutal wordmark grows to 1.125rem.

components.css: .ds-panel { --depth: 5px; position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 3px; transform: rotate(-0.44deg); transition: transform 0.18s; } .ds-panel::before, .ds-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; } .ds-panel::before { z-index: -2; transform: translate(calc(var(--depth) + 6px), calc(var(--depth) + 7px)); background-image: radial-gradient(var(--cast, rgb(20 16 31 / 0.55)) 34%, transparent 38%); background-size: 6px 6px; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-panel::after { z-index: -1; background: var(--paper, #fbfcff); border: 3px solid var(--ink, #14101f); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--extrude, #14101f), 2px 2px 0 var(--extrude, #14101f), 3px 3px 0 var(--extrude, #14101f), calc(var(--depth) - 1px) calc(var(--depth) - 1px) 0 var(--extrude, #14101f), var(--depth) var(--depth) 0 var(--extrude, #14101f); transition: box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-panel:hover { --depth: 8px; transform: rotate(-0.44deg) translateY(-3px); } .ds-check { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0; border: 3px solid var(--ink, #14101f); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper, #fbfcff); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--ink-text, #14101f); } .ds-panel-meta { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; font-stretch: 85%; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4360); }

narrative.overview:
TaskBoard is one task manager wearing three complete, user-selectable skins. The board itself never changes: the same tasks, filters, composer, states, ES/EN language switch, theme toggle and accessible structure come from one shared behaviour layer, and each skin re-draws all of it in its own world. Comic is the default; the visitor switches with the style-switch row under the top bar of every skin, and the choice is remembered in this browser. A skin is total: it owns the page ground, the body face, selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbar and the browser's theme colour, so no surface ever shows a half-switched mix.

The three worlds are deliberately far apart. **Comic, "The Printed Comic Page"**, prints the board as a four-colour comic page with inked panels and stepped animation. **Brutal, "The Pressable Slab Board"**, builds it from heavy Nightfall-outlined slabs on a Tropical Pink ground that lift under the cursor and sink when pressed. **Classic, "The Original Soft Board"**, is the original TaskBoard restored as-is: Inter, zinc neutrals, a violet accent and soft translucent cards. Each has light and dark editions and its own depth system; none borrows another's.

**Comic (default).** TaskBoard's Comic skin is a page of a comic book that happens to be a task manager. Every surface is a panel drawn in 2D that fakes 3D: white paper, a thick near-black ink outline, a stepped ink extrusion to the lower right, and a Ben-Day halftone shadow cast behind it. The page sits over a parallax sky: a cyan dotted sky by day, a violet night with magenta dots after dark, with speed lines, a halftone sun or moon, and two layers of inked skyline drifting at different depths with the pointer and scroll. Everything is CSS and inline SVG; the skin ships no raster art. The palette is four-colour process print: cyan, magenta, yellow and ink on paper. Display type is hand-lettered comic (Bangers) with cyan and magenta plates knocked out of register; working text is Archivo, a variable grotesque whose width axis condenses labels the way a letterer would. Motion is animated "on twos": scripted transitions advance in stepped frames instead of smooth easing, so the page moves like drawn animation. Completing a task triggers the signature onomatopoeia burst. The style is inspired by the comic art direction of *Into the Spider-Verse* and stops at the art style. The skin carries no characters, logos, or franchise imagery. Personality never gets in the way of the task: titles stay plain Archivo, controls stay obvious, and every decorative motion turns off under reduced motion.

**Brutal.** Kinetic Neo-Brutalism in the user-pinned "Ponche Tropical" palette. Every card and button is a warm-white slab with a 4px Nightfall border and a 6px zero-blur Nightfall shadow; under a real pointer it lifts diagonally with its shadow growing to 10px, and pressing sinks it fully onto the page. Type is Archivo at weight 900 stretched wide for shouts and plain bold Archivo for content. The header is a bento grid, the board's live counts ride two full-bleed, tilted Liquid Sunset marquees that accelerate with scroll, a Heatwave stamp pops when a task is finished, and on wide screens hand-drawn SVG stickers sit in the margins to be dragged around. Night re-grounds the board on Nightfall while the accents stay put.

**Classic.** The original TaskBoard design restored at the user's request: a near-white or near-black canvas with a faint masked grid and slowly breathing violet, indigo, sky and fuchsia halos, translucent white cards with hairline zinc borders and a backdrop blur, violet-to-indigo gradient accents on the logo tile, add button and progress ring, emerald completion checks, and a waving 👋 after the greeting. It is kept faithful on purpose; its only changes are accessibility and fit fixes (listed under Components), not restyling.
keyCharacteristics: Three total skins (Comic default, Brutal, Classic) over one shared behaviour layer; switching re-draws everything, never mixes.
Each skin owns its page ground, body face, selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbar and browser theme colour.
Comic: inked panels with ink extrusion plus halftone cast shadow as the only depth system.
Comic: four-colour process palette; yellow narrator captions; magenta as the "done/active" plate.
Comic: Bangers lettering with cyan/magenta misregistration for display and SFX only; Archivo for everything you read.
Comic: stepped "on twos" timing for scripted motion; springs only for direct hover and tap response.
Comic: slight hand-pasted tilt on panels; small radii (2-4px) so panels read as cut paper, not cards.
Comic: day and night are two full printings of the same page, not a dimmed copy.
Brutal: Nightfall 4px borders and 0-blur offset shadows; tactile lift-and-sink press on a pinned overshoot curve.
Brutal: wide Archivo 900 display, Liquid Sunset marquees, Paradise secondary cards and tickets, Heatwave calls to action.
Classic: the restored original, soft translucent cards, zinc plus violet, Inter, light motion.

rules.name: The Process Plate Rule
rules.body: In Comic, colour comes from the four process plates and the paper. A new accent needs a print reason; there is no fifth hue in the skin.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink On Yellow Rule
rules.body: Anything set on Process Yellow uses fixed ink (#14101f) regardless of theme. Yellow never flips, so its text never flips.

rules.name: The Two Printings Rule
rules.body: Night is a second print run: the ground goes violet, the extrusion goes magenta, the cast dots go cyan, the windows go magenta. Never build dark mode by dimming the day palette.

rules.name: The Nightfall Line Rule
rules.body: Every border, shadow and outline in Brutal is the one line colour (Nightfall by day, Night Line by night). Lines never take an accent.

rules.name: The Fixed Nightfall On Accent Rule
rules.body: Text and icons on Heatwave and Liquid Sunset are Nightfall (#351c4d) in both themes; text on Paradise is warm white. Accents never flip, so what sits on them never flips.

rules.name: The Re-Grounded Night Rule
rules.body: Night moves the ground to Nightfall and the slabs to Night Slab; Heatwave, Liquid Sunset and Paradise stay exactly as they are.

rules.name: The Restored Original Rule
rules.body: Classic reproduces the original design as the user asked. Its violet gradients, blur halos, translucent cards and 👋 belong to Classic only and are not a pattern for Comic, Brutal or any new surface.

rules.name: The Lettering Is Shouted Rule
rules.body: Bangers carries only shouts: greetings, SFX, button calls, counts and empty-state titles. User content and anything read twice is Archivo.

rules.name: The Width Not Size Rule
rules.body: To fit a label, condense its width axis (100% to 85% to 78%) before shrinking it below 0.75rem.

rules.name: The Stretch Is The Shout Rule
rules.body: Brutal shouts by width and weight (900 at 110-118%), never by a second family. User content is never stretched or uppercased.

rules.name: The Width Not Size Rule (Brutal)
rules.body: When labels must fit a narrow phone, drop the width axis (filter tabs go to 75%, skin plates to 95%) before shrinking the size.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: On the comic page, depth is ink extrusion plus halftone cast, never a blur. If a shadow has a blur radius, it does not belong on this page.

rules.name: The Depth Is State Rule
rules.body: A panel's distance from the page is its state: raised on hover or focus, flattened when done. Change --depth; don't add a new shadow.

rules.name: The Zero-Blur Rule
rules.body: Every Brutal shadow is a Nightfall offset with no blur. Depth never softens.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Hover lifts (-4px, shadow 10px), press sinks (+6px, shadow 0), both on the user-pinned overshoot curve cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) over 0.22s, carried by `translate`, with hover lift gated to hover-capable fine pointers.

dos: Do (all skins) keep one behaviour layer: a skin changes how the board looks, moves and sounds, never what it does or what it exposes to assistive tech; copy may take the skin's voice (Comic's own empty-state title, punctuation stripped from Brutal and Classic greetings).
Do (all skins) switch the whole skin at once through `data-skin`, including page ground, body face, selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbar and theme colour, and set it before first paint.
Do (all skins) build every new surface in all three skins, each in its own grammar.
Do (Comic) build every raised surface as an inked panel: paper, 3px ink border, stepped extrusion (default 5px depth) and a 6px halftone cast.
Do (Comic) express state through depth: 8px on hover, 7px on focus, 2px when done, 3px for small controls.
Do (Comic) time scripted motion on twos with stepped easing (floor(p * n) / n, or CSS steps()), 4-13 frames; keep springs for direct hover and tap response.
Do (Comic) set lettering (Bangers with ink stroke, ink extrusion and offset cyan/magenta plates) only on shouted display text: greetings, SFX, the logotype.
Do (Comic) put fixed ink (#14101f) on Process Yellow in both themes.
Do (Comic) give panels a slight, stable tilt (within about plus or minus 0.7deg for list items, up to 2deg for single features).
Do (Comic) draw decoration as CSS gradients and inline SVG; disable every decorative motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do (Brutal) build raised surfaces as slabs: warm white, 4px Nightfall border, 14px radius, 6px zero-blur Nightfall shadow.
Do (Brutal) scale small controls down to 3px or 2px borders and 4px resting shadows.

Do (Brutal) make slabs and controls pressable with the Press Rule: lift -4px with a 10px shadow on hover-capable fine pointers, sink +6px to shadow 0 on press, on cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) over 0.22s, using `translate`.
Do (Brutal) keep spring physics for entrances, plates, stamps and stickers, and stop the marquee and the cursor under reduced motion.
Do (Brutal) set Nightfall (#351c4d) on Heatwave and Liquid Sunset and warm white on Paradise, in both themes.
Do (Brutal) render stickers only from 1024px and the custom cursor only for fine pointers.
Do (Classic) keep Classic faithful to the original; change it only for accessibility or fit.
donts: Don't (all skins) mix skins: no inked panels or Bangers outside Comic, no slabs or Nightfall offsets outside Brutal, no translucent blur cards or violet gradients outside Classic.
Don't (all skins) fork behaviour per skin: tasks, filters, validation, shortcuts and accessible names stay identical across all three.
Don't (Comic) use blurred shadows, glassy blur, or soft floating cards; depth is printed.
Don't (Comic) use violet-to-pink gradients or any gradient other than halftone dots, speed lines and the sky masks.
Don't (Comic) set task titles or any user content in Bangers.
Don't (Comic) introduce characters, logos or franchise imagery; the reference is art style only.
Don't (Comic) add a hue outside cyan, magenta, yellow, ink and paper (danger and the status green excepted).
Don't (Comic) round panels beyond 4px; a pill or a 12px card breaks the cut-paper silhouette.
Don't (Brutal) use blur, soft shadows or gradient fills; every shadow is a 0-blur Nightfall offset.
Don't (Brutal) leave hover lift active on touch, or carry lift and sink on `transform`, which Motion owns for entrances.
Don't (Brutal) add a hue outside Ponche Tropical (Nightfall, Tropical Pink, warm white, Liquid Sunset, Heatwave, Paradise and their night tints), the online mint excepted.
Don't (Classic) carry its violet gradients, blur halos or 👋 into other skins or new surfaces; they exist because the user asked for the original restored.
Don't (Classic) move the date back into an eyebrow above the greeting.
